data.title: Employees by citizenship in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi

metadata.label: Indicator name
metadata.value: Employees by citizenship in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi - annually

metadata.label: Indicator description
metadata.value: This indicator measures the distribution of employees by citizenship in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi  Employees by citizenship: It represents the number of employed persons classified by citizenship status (Emirati and Non-Emirati) residing or working in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi

metadata.label: Keywords
metadata.value: Employees by citizenship, Emirati, Non-Emirati, workforce distribution, citizenship

metadata.label: Statistical population
metadata.value: The statistical population includes all individuals aged 15 years and above who reside in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. The following are excluded: visitors to the Emirate who have stayed for less than six months, residents of institutions such as hospitals, psychiatric facilities, elderly care homes, orphanages, and hotels, members of the diplomatic corps, armed forces personnel, security camps, and palace residents.

metadata.label: Geographic coverage
metadata.value: Geographical coverage includes the three regions in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi: Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, and Al Dhafra.

metadata.label: Statistical calculation method
metadata.value: Count of employed persons residing or working in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi classified by citizenship status (Emirati / Non-Emirati) - annually

aiRecommendation.title: Balance Emiratisation with Sustained Economic Growth
aiRecommendation.title_ar: تحقيق التوازن بين التوطين والنمو الاقتصادي المستدام
aiRecommendation.text: The significant gap between Emirati and Non-Emirati employees underscores the need for targeted Emiratisation policies that expand local workforce participation without disrupting productivity.
aiRecommendation.text_ar: يؤكد الفارق الكبير بين الموظفين الإماراتيين وغير الإماراتيين الحاجة إلى سياسات توطين مستهدفة تعزز مشاركة القوى العاملة المحلية دون الإخلال بالإنتاجية.
aiRecommendation.reason: Non-Emirati employees consistently outnumber Emirati employees by a factor of roughly six. Both groups are growing, but the ratio remains wide. Sustained workforce nationalisation programmes are critical to improving this balance while maintaining economic output.
aiRecommendation.reason_ar: يتجاوز عدد الموظفين غير الإماراتيين باستمرار عدد نظرائهم الإماراتيين بنحو ستة أضعاف. وكلا المجموعتين في تنامٍ مستمر، غير أن الفجوة لا تزال واسعة. ويُعدّ استمرار برامج التوطين أمراً بالغ الأهمية لتحسين هذا الميزان مع الحفاظ على الناتج الاقتصادي.
